title: Chapter 553
paragraphs: Chapter 553
Episode 145: Omen (22)
Kieeeeeek-!
A piercing scream resounded throughout the battlefield. A similar sound was heard in 1795 when Andrey Zipple was cornered and took out the Demon God Stone.
However, the situation was different now. The current Demon God Stone was in a much more advanced state compared to then.
'Has Kelliark started using the Demon God Stone in earnest...?'

As soon as the second round began, Jin and his comrades knew that Kelliark had brought the Demon God Stone. Quicantel was terrified, and the Zipple dragons, even with safety devices around their necks, seemed on the verge of convulsions.
Despite that, feeling the power of the Demon God Stone being unleashed gave them goosebumps.
"That power was originally hidden to confront Runcandel. It seems your ruler has finally decided that he can't deal with Lon Kyung."
Although he calmly responded, Jin couldn't help but consider the possibility that the tide of battle could turn. Both in the sky and on the ground.
As soon as the Demon God Stone was activated, Octavia's recovery accelerated. Jin remembered the conversation he had with Sandra Zipple in the Gaipa Army.
-Should we get married? They say there's a proposal with the grace of the Rainbow Garden, what about me?
-I'll consider it if you tell me the secret of your regenerative ability.
-Really? It's not a difficult condition. Have you heard of the Demon God Stone? We can imitate some of the powers of the gods with it...
'Super-regeneration by the Demon God Stone...'
The remaining flames of the fire on Octavia's amputated right hand withered away. Instead, black smoke rose, forming a new hand.
He had witnessed the same regeneration in 1795 when Andrey fought Vuletta. Black bones were created, and a dull, eerie flesh sprouted.
Octavia wasn't the only one recovering.
The injured Phantom Corps members also began regaining their strength through super-regeneration... and even the dead Phantoms were disgustingly squirming as they got back on their feet.
Soon, Octavia used the power of light to reassemble her broken staff and locked eyes with Jin. Dark blood still flowed from her left eye.
"Yes, both Lon Hairan and you. You have shocked us too much."
"Why haven't you healed your eye?"
"To never forget this day."
"You wouldn't be able to forget it anyway. You're doing all these useless things."
Although Jin spoke calmly, it was difficult to swallow the regret. The opportunity to finish off Octavia had disappeared.
If that was all, they could have somehow accepted this bitter situation. However, the problem was that, unlike them, most of their allies were injured or exhausted.
The participation of Runcandel or Talaris was desperately needed in this situation.
"......My Lord."
Valkas stood by Jin's side and spoke.
"We must retreat now."
The voice of Valkas, saying so, was low and somber.
He was recalling a conversation he had with Casimir before the start of the second battle.
-...I think this war is not just about the Sword Emperor Castle, it might be deciding the fate of the world.
-I feel the same way.

-Even if Lord Dante wakes up, and we all escape from the Sword Emperor Castle, it would only be delaying the inevitable. An all-out war, negotiations. One of these two must occur. As long as the white stone is not destroyed.

-We must focus on supporting our lord in any situation. Our lord will never give up on his friend, but if that puts our lord in danger of falling... we must prevent our lord from falling, even if we have to trample on his heart.
Valkas felt that now was the time.
If they didn't retreat now, the future that Jin and the Vamel Alliance, as well as the Sword Saints, could face seemed to be nothing but death.
Of course, for Valkas, Jin's survival was not comparable to Dante's life. Everyone in the Vamel Alliance felt the same.
Especially, they couldn't leave Jin to die in this hopeless battle. If the Demon God Stone hadn't healed Octavia and the Phantoms, it might have been different, but now there was really no solution.
Valkas was frustrated to the point of madness, but especially in such times, he had to accept reality coolly.
"My Lord... you've done enough."
His grip on the sword tightened, and his teeth gritted as if they were going to break.
Jin knew better than anyone else that Valkas was right.
Eventually, Jin made a choice.
"We will retreat."
Of course, Jin had no intention of ever giving up on Dante...
Continuing to fight would only lead to death for himself and those who followed him.
The name 'Jin Runcandel' and the influence he holds are no longer solely personal. The lives of numerous comrades depended on him.
To abandon them all for a friend who might have already crossed an irretrievable river would be no different from betrayal. It was a choice that should never be made as their lord and comrade.
"But... I need to see the inner fortress at least once."
If there is really no hope even after retreating to the inner fortress where Dante is, if there is absolutely no way to save him, then he will definitely retreat. That's what Jin was saying.
"My Lord, it might be harder to retreat from the inner fortress."
"No, on the contrary, going to the inner fortress increases everyone's chances of survival. The family can't observe up to the inner fortress, so they'll definitely send someone."
In fact, Rosa had already ordered the Black Knight Captain Stan to save Jin at all costs.
The people of Runcandel wouldn't care about anyone else's life but Jin's, but if they were to fight with Octavia, it was inevitable that the escape of the party would become easier.
Another giant who was still neutral, the lord of infinity, Talaris Endorma, might also be in the inner fortress.
Above all,
Jin was remembering an old memory. The day when his eldest sister, Luna Runcandel, slashed the Demon God Stone. It seemed that there was nothing that the current Ron could not cut in this world.
Runcandel, Talaris, and Ron. As the intervention of Runcandel among the three was certain, there was no reason not to check the inner fortress, and Valkas agreed.
By then, Octavia had finished recovering. Again, magic of various lights and chain magic were flying towards the party.
Zzzrng-!
Valkas stepped forward, knocking down a beam that had fallen towards Jin.
"I will retreat while guarding the rear with the Sword Saints. My Lord, head to the inner fortress as quickly as possible with the rest of the people."
Eyes were completely empty, and the black face twisted in places replaced the sky.
It was a face that popped out of the Demon God Stone. Kiack, Kiyeack-! It seemed to be in great pain as it screamed incessantly, showing its face to the outside world.
Perhaps it wasn't a scream but a roar threatening enemies, or just a meaningless groan.

What was clear was that its gloomy and terrifying voice was overwhelming everyone in the Sword Emperor Castle. Even Ron High, he felt his body heavy, looking directly at the face of the Demon God Stone.
He had never seen anything more terrifying in his life. It wasn't just a feeling that came from the grotesque form, an indescribably deep and dark energy was dyeing the battlefield.
'That... Did Zipple, a human, really create that?'
Until now, he had never wavered a bit, even when facing Kelliark and Zipple's fleet alone.
But not now.
He just...
It seemed impossible to defeat. If there was a human who could defeat that in the world, he thought it would only be Chiron.
He had the 'certainty' that if not him, no one else could defeat it. It was a certainty that only the closest to the realm of creation, a martial artist, could have.
'Dante, my grandson.'
Dante's face came to mind.
Along with the thought that he might not be able to protect that child, he wondered what he could do for his grandson.
There was only one.
'If I fail to protect you, I will make sure that you at least can return alive.'
Rashid had made up his mind.
He had made up his mind and will to push away the certainty of defeat. If he fought without pushing away that certainty, there would never be an upset.
Before long, Ron was able to face the face of the Demon God Stone with the same look as usual.
"Ron High. I never thought I'd have to use this power against you."
Kelliark appeared in front of the face of the Demon God Stone and said.
He looked completely different from before. He didn't look like an old man with white hair, but like a young boy.
And Ron intuitively knew that this was a phenomenon that occurred as a result of Kelliark and the Demon God Stone's fusion.
"It's a show of respect."

"How can a monster show respect to a human, Kelliark Zipple. You're no longer the enemy I knew, a human. I'm disgusted to the point of even the fact that I once competed with you as a human to human."
At those words, Kelliark smiled bitterly.
"I understand."
The Huroti was dyed black. It was a dark and deep black color, enough to say that it was dyed with spirit.
"The only consideration I can make for you is to let you rest as soon as possible."
A black flash spread from the Huroti. The black flash was soundless and without signs. Just like a spirit sword at its peak.
At the same time, Ron swung Rashid.
However, Ron did not think it was 'simultaneous'. He perceived that his reaction was delayed by a second, or even a significantly lower unit of time.
The black flash was touching Ron, easily breaking through the huge invisible sword energy that was spread between them.
Thanks to the very slight delay caused by the invisible sword energy, Ron was able to overcome the time difference and perfectly deflect the black flash.
Screech-!
A strange sound was heard when Rashid and the black flash collided.
And Ron had to feel the black flash, which he thought he had definitely deflected, brushing past his cheek.
Something that should not have happened at his level occurred.
Kiack, Kiyeack!
The Demon God Stone's scream sounded as if it was mocking such Ron.
On the back of Ron's hand, wiping the blood flowing on his cheek with a stern face, ash-colored runes were emerging.
He had opened the Overlord Sword.
